Cc: [contact omitted] Meral Karan, [contact omitted] Diana Parzik, [contact omitted] Rosarie Tucci, [contact omitted]
Sophia Lalani
+ Sophia, who is going to run point for the front office on this issue.
Ihave been offline quite a bit for the past several daysdealing with COVID-related issues, and here's a summary from
Gideon of SP's thinking on this from a meeting I missed last week.
"On the disinformation front -- this just came up quite extensively in small group again today. this isn't clearly bounded so
part of this will be to figure out what we can usefully do. One piece of this will be understanding what USAID's capabilities
are. So that probably means engaging the DRG and ITR folks (maybe others) to understand what we do in this space.
And then it's probably a good idea to collect info on what we've actually done (if anything) in places like Ethiopia, Ukraine,
and Nepal to counter disinformation. This would be mini-case studies to better understand what we do/ don't do. And then
ultimately the bigger piece will be the interagency - SP wants to engage Jake to set up a process on this."
On Tue, Jan 18, 2022 at 10:57 AM Johnny Walsh <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Adding Meral, who I think would be our relevant team lead on this, and Diana who's been working the interagency
process on Information Integrity; there are others we could add as well. Yes we have some capability, and yes it would
be great to help the USG radically up its game on this. Maybe a meeting among all of us would be in order, where you
can elaborate on what SP said, and we can explain what we have in play?
On Tue, Jan 18, 2022 at 10:41 AM Colin Thomas-Jensen <[contact omitted] wrote:
hey Johnny and Ro --
Is there any inhouse expertise within the DG center on countering disinformation? SP pushing hard for us to get an
interagency process going on how the USG can get a LOT better at this and I am trying to get a sense of what our
capacity looks like to be a thought leader here.
Colin

To: [contact omitted] Rosarie Tucci, [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh, [contact omitted] Diana Parzik
Hi all
Just dropping it down to the DRG folks for a moment. It's like people are reading our minds! Diana and I have been
saying that we would really like to raise this to the Administrator's attention and I agree we need to loop in Josh and
Lauren (CSM) in particular too. Eventually this really has to be more of a whole of Agency issue because
mis/dis/malinformation (MDM) is impacting health, climate change, and economic growth portfolios and certainly the
digital space too.
We (Johnny, Lauren, Josh, Diana and I) already planned to meet tomorrow and touch base on where we are on MDM
approaches and where we think we need to go. We could then also brainstorm how to approach this ask so we can do a
presentation to SP. Ro, I added you and David to that meeting. (Sorry I should have done so earlier!)
Thanks,
Meral
